subject: the orchestrator's four deploy-safety instruments, plus verify-published-game.mjs
headline_findings: check-shipped-files.mjs cannot see game/vendor/three/three.core.js — the renderer — because the import sits behind a binding list longer than its 200-char regex window. Two more real imports from engine.js are invisible for the same reason.
It is BLOCKING and fires on four shapes of sound tree, one of which is a neighbour's untracked scratch file under game/ — that blocks every agent on the box and blocks tools/bank.mjs. Rule 13.
Its --self-test never executes the scanner. I built the missing arm; the tool does catch the real defect (scenario A).

verify-playable.mjs samples the bottom-left 160x160 corner, 1.23% of the frame, and calls four legitimate states blank: midnight (corner 0.00%, frame 52.86%), dungeon_primary (0.02/33.30) and two more. The 2% threshold is fine; the window is not.
Its four viewports render one identical 1920x1080 framebuffer — main.js skips the resize path under navigator.webdriver — so the phone framebuffer is never tested.
The framebuffer read latches: a getContext call before the renderer exists zeroes the number permanently. Isolated with a differing control.
The boot notice hid at 876 ms against an 8.8-91 s load — confirmed, and fixed by its author at fa96455 mid-round.

The FIX ships the same corner-sampling defect into the game: dungeon_primary draws 33.35% and the notice never hides, leaving a full-screen overlay a player cannot dismiss. 2 runs of 2, with a screenshot.
The window.fetch monkey-patch is determinism-neutral (measured, digests identical, control bit) but never fired in any of nine sabotage arms.
https://…/play/ returned 404 during this round while nothing was watching, because verify-live-site.mjs is not wired into anything.
contention: node tools/contention.mjs --gate returned GO before every browser run. Figures were taken between 1.03 and 4.70 per core with 1-5 other browsers; each figure in the verdict states its load (rule 26). One browser launched and kept per run.
could_not_do: Did not reproduce the rule-13 false positive on the live tree; planting an untracked file under game/ would have blocked a neighbour's commit. Used a byte-identical copy of the tool in a fixture repo instead.
barge-hold and cam_cistern did not come up under the dark probe and are excluded.
The --notice2 timing run returned nothing usable at 4.70/core and is reported as not-run.
game/ at HEAD did not boot during the night-notice run (a neighbour's QuestBook integrity failures), so notice figures are pinned to a git archive of fa96455.
My first night-notice run printed PASS over six states that drew nothing — a fail-open in my own instrument, now exits 2 with NOT RUN.
next_step: none — verdict delivered. The four cheapest fixes, in order: (1) skip untracked files in check-shipped-files' walk, which closes the rule-13 block on the fleet; (2) stride the whole frame instead of the bottom-left corner, in BOTH verify-playable and the boot notice's painted(), which un-breaks dungeons and nights; (3) await __HARNESS.ready() instead of waiting 15 s; (4) wire verify-live-site into the TICK loop.
